title: Integration batch
description: The manifest of one batch (ADR 0114), under .ai/repo/integration/batches/: the master it was composed on and, in composition order, each member pull request with the head that was merged and the merge commit on the batch's first-parent line that carries it. Written by `majordomus prs compose --apply` in the batch's one composition commit and by nothing else; it lands with the batch. The `batch-check` gate compares it with the branch that carries it, and `prs explain` and the Cockpit read it.

id.description: The batch's identity, derived and never chosen: the first ten characters of the master it was composed on, then each member's number in composition order. The file is named after it, and the batch's branch is int/batch-<id>.

base.description: The integration base the batch targets.

base_master.description: The commit of the base the batch was composed on: the first parent of the first member's merge commit.

version_before.description: The version the composed tree declared after the member merges and before the one `release bump` of the composition (ADR 0114 D6). Absent when the tree declares no version.

version_after.description: The version the composition commit declares. Equal to version_before when the public contract of the composed tree required nothing above it and no bump was written.

members.description: The members, in composition order: the order of their merge commits on the batch's first-parent line.

head.description: The head that was merged: the second parent of the member's merge commit.

title.description: The member's title, as the forge reported it when the batch was composed.

merge_commit.description: The merge commit on the batch's first-parent line that carries the member.
